reference: Cockburn & Shu, JCP 141 (1998) 199-224, Part V; Kopriva & Batta, JCP 270 (2014) 550 (metric identities)
description: Curvilinear (isoparametric) DG for 2D Euler equations — interface orientation and flux trace fix. The pre-fix assembly had low faces carrying the interior physical trace in the inward orientation, producing a positive eigenvalue of +2.1 in the linearised spectrum (anti-dissipative). The fix reverses the low-face normal so all faces use the outward reference normal, matching the high-face convention.

physics.scheme: Strong-form modal DG, tensor-product Legendre basis
physics.domain: Box [0,10] x [0,10] with sinusoidal warp (amplitude 0.06, strength 1 or 5)
physics.mesh: 2x2 elements (4 DOF per cell for p0, 16 for p1)

evidence_lines.title: Linear spectrum about uniform flow
evidence_lines.description: Max real eigenvalue of dU/dt about a uniform flow. Pre-fix has positive eigenvalues (unstable); fixed is neutral (round-off).

evidence_lines.title: Design order — smooth isentropic vortex
evidence_lines.description: Relative L2 error on straight and warped meshes at p=1,2. Design order p+1, paper tolerance p+1/2.

evidence_lines.title: Conservation over finite-time march
evidence_lines.description: Total mass/momentum/energy drift on 8x8 mesh, strength 5, t=0.5.

evidence_lines.title: Wall-bounded channel — reflective wall stability
evidence_lines.description: Semi-discrete residual on exact uniform slip state, then time march to observe round-off growth.
evidence_lines.details: operator_defect: 1.03e-14 (PASS); blowup at step 694 — reflective wall remains linearly unstable but ~10x slower than pre-fix
